{"openapi":"3.1.0","info":{"title":"Nuvolve CRM API","version":"2026-11-01","description":"Connect Nuvolve to your own systems: a data warehouse, accounting, call tracking, ad platforms, or Zapier.

**Keys.** An owner or admin makes keys in Settings → API & integrations. Each key belongs to one company, has only the permissions picked for it, and can be held to one branch. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer nvk_...`. A key is shown once; turning it off takes effect right away.

**Lists** come newest first, 25 at a time (up to 100 with `limit`). When `has_more` is true, pass `next_cursor` as `starting_after`.

**Retries.** Send an `Idempotency-Key` header on any POST or PATCH. Sending the same key again within 24 hours returns the first answer and does nothing new.

**Limits.** 120 requests a minute per key, the same for every key and every endpoint. Every answer has `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (Unix seconds). Past the limit you get a 429 with `Retry-After` in seconds: wait that long, then carry on. Need more for a one-time import? Ask support.

**Versions.** `/nuvolve/app/api/v1` only changes for a rewrite. Breaking changes inside it get a dated version; this is `2026-11-01`. Leave the `Nuvolve-Version` header off to get the newest, or send it to pin one. Every answer says which version it used. New endpoints, new optional fields, new fields in answers, new events and new enum values are not breaking, so write clients that ignore what they don't know. Versions so far: `2026-11-01` (The first dated version: /nuvolve/app/api/v1 as it stands on this date.).

**Deprecations.** Anything we'll remove is announced at least 180 days before its sunset date, in the changelog, on `GET /meta`, and by email to companies whose keys still call it. Until the sunset it keeps working and answers with `Deprecation`, `Sunset` and `Link` headers; after it, a 410. Nothing is deprecated right now.

**Sandbox.** An owner or admin makes one in Settings → API & integrations: a separate copy of the company with three sample customers, a tech and the default services, and its own full-permission key. The API works exactly the same; answers carry `Nuvolve-Mode: sandbox`, `GET /me` says `livemode: false`, and nothing is ever texted or emailed from it (webhooks do go out). Wipe it back to the sample data at any time.

**Rules.** Your company's scheduling rules (card on file, licensed tech, price floor, service area…) apply to the API too. A blocked request gets a 422 with `error.rules` listing each one. Keys can't override rules.

**Webhooks.** Every delivery is a POST of an Event with these headers: `Nuvolve-Event`, `Nuvolve-Event-Id`, `Nuvolve-Delivery`, and `Nuvolve-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>`. v1 is the HMAC-SHA256 of `<t>.<raw body>` using the webhook secret. Answer with any 2xx within 10 seconds. Anything else is retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 12 h. Answer 410 to unsubscribe. A webhook that gives up on 5 events in a row is switched off.
